name: the_state_counts_selected_edges_and_faces
why: Z-C21.3, findings C7-2 and N14 (lot Z-C21.7/.8), measured real by the edge-count probe on 28/9/2026 (the Z-C21.3 outcome in the TODO). C7-2: the state wrote the fillet's edge count from ISimpleFilletFeatureData2.FilletItemsCount only when it was above zero, and FilletItemsCount «returns -1 if this simple fillet feature is not multiple radius» (FilletItemsCount.html, Remarks): the bridge makes only uniform fillets, the probe read -1 on every one of them, so the count never came out. N14: the count that does work, GetEdgeCount on the definition, is the number of SELECTED edges: one top edge of a rounded block, filleted with the bridge's options, propagates along the tangent loop and gives 8 faces, and GetEdgeCount says 1. The same on a chamfer. Now the state writes «selected_edges» (GetEdgeCount) and «faces» (IFeature.GetFaceCount, «Gets the number of faces in this feature») on every fillet and chamfer, so one selected edge that became a whole loop reads as 1 and 8.
defect_caught: Step 2 rounds the four vertical edges: on library 0.141.0 it is RED at its second expectation: no fillet entry carries an edge count at all (FilletItemsCount -1, the field is skipped), so no feature entry reads «selected_edges=4». Steps 3 and 4 take N14: one selected top edge filleted r 2 and one selected bottom edge chamfered 2 x 45, each propagating to the 8 edges of its loop. «selected_edges» must say 1 and «faces» 8: a state that wrote the selection as the worked edges, or the faces as the selection, fails here, and the volume proves the whole loop was worked (one edge alone would remove 28.872 and 69.119, probe F8n and C8n).
_the_edges_by_where_they_are: The block of the probe: on the Top plane, 40 along X, 30 along Z, 20 high along +Y from y = 0 (stato.ingombro_da_mm is asked in step 1 so the selectors below are not guesses). The vertical edges at x = ±20, z = ±15. After they are rounded, the top straight edge along X at z = +15 runs from x = -15 to +15 at y = 20, its middle point is (0, 20, 15); the bottom one is the same at y = 0.
_the_numbers: Block 40 x 30 x 20 = 24000. Four vertical edges r 5: 4 x (1 - pi/4) x 5^2 x 20 = 429.204, left 23570.796 (probe F4: removed 429.204, GetEdgeCount 4, faces 4). Fillet r 2 on the rounded top loop: section (1 - pi/4) x 2^2 = 0.8584 along 100 mm of straight edges (85.841) plus four quarter arcs of radius 5 with the section's centroid 0.22337 x 2 in from the corner, by Pappus 24.558: 110.399, left 23460.397 (probe F8: removed 110.399, GetEdgeCount 1 with or without AccessSelections, faces 8, FilletItemsCount -1). Chamfer 2 x 45 on the rounded bottom loop: triangle 2 mm2 along 100 mm (200) plus four quarter arcs with the centroid 2/3 in from the corner (54.454): 254.454, left 23205.943 (probe C8: removed 254.454, GetEdgeCount 1, faces 8, Type 1 angle-distance).
_the_reply: N14 on the reply, added in the review of Z-C21.2-ter: the replies of raccordo_spigoli and smusso_spigoli keep `spigoli` (the edges passed, as before, for the cases that read it) and now carry the same two fields as the state, «selected_edges» and «faces» (IFeature.GetFaceCount of the new feature, read right after it is made, as the probe read it). Steps 2, 3 and 4 assert them next to the state.
_what_is_not_measured: The vertex chamfer of N29 cannot be built by any operation of the bridge: it is covered in Prove by «the state reads a chamfer by its type (N29)».

expect.why: C7-2: some fillet entry carries its edge count. On library 0.141.0 none does (FilletItemsCount -1), and this is where the case goes red
the list is in creation order: the extrusion, then this fillet. The index is checked here before its fields are read
the four selected edges, GetEdgeCount on the definition (probe F4: 4)
four rounded faces, one per edge: nothing to propagate to (probe F4: 4)
the reply says the same as the state: four edges selected
